This is a tour of the Agano area's countryside, where you'll see, hear, and taste the seasons. Konnyaku yams take about 3 years to grow.

【Fee】
Adults ¥4,000 / Elementary school children ¥3,000 / Preschoolers ¥1,500 (includes guide, insurance, lunch, etc.)

【Capacity】
3 groups (2–4 people per group)

【Guide】
Taira Kuri-en staff

【What to bring】
Drink, apron, headscarf, towel, mask

【More information】
Taira Kuri-en website: https://tairakurien.com/

summary: Experience the countryside with all five senses — make homemade konnyaku (konjac) during this tour!
